Method of Attack: Memory exhaustion denial-of-service (DoS) via crafted IGMP traffic exploiting DVMRP feature
Pre-auth critical remote code execution (RCE), authentication bypass, and static default credential vulnerabilities
Discoverer: Cisco Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT)
Impacted Systems: Cisco IOS XR routers with multicast routing enabled
Multiple Cisco firewall and router devices
Attack Vector: Sending crafted IGMP traffic to affected devices
Pre-authentication remote code execution and authentication bypass
